name: @techysy/cardsheet
description: 把若干图片拼到一张可打印的大图上（纸张预设 / 间距 / 裁切线），打印后按格裁切

scripts.check: node --check bin/cardsheet.js && node --check src/sheet.js && node --check src/pdf.js && node --check src/index.js && node --check test/smoke.js
scripts.release: npm run check && npm test && npm version patch && npm run publish:npm && git push --follow-tags
scripts.release:minor: npm run check && npm test && npm version minor && npm run publish:npm && git push --follow-tags
scripts.release:major: npm run check && npm test && npm version major && npm run publish:npm && git push --follow-tags

author: techysy
